purpose: Evidence-driven DPDP readiness validation; not legal certification.

status_policy.PASS: Required evidence was supplied and all required verification results passed.
status_policy.FAIL: A required technical or behavioral verification failed. This is not a legal finding by itself.
status_policy.REVIEW: A source/config candidate or conflicting/partial evidence needs contextual review.
status_policy.UNKNOWN: The check is applicable/current but required evidence is missing.
status_policy.NOT_APPLICABLE: Applicability facts support non-applicability and the rationale is recorded.
status_policy.FUTURE_EFFECTIVE: The modeled legal obligation is not yet effective; readiness evidence may still be collected.

checks.title: India nexus and material scope
checks.verify: Determine Act s3 route (processing in India of data collected digitally or later digitised, or qualifying outside-India processing connected to offering goods/services to Data Principals in India) and s3(c) exclusions from explicit project facts and legal evidence.

checks.title: Standalone itemised notice
runtime_tests: Open each personal-data collection flow and confirm the notice is independently understandable, itemises personal data and specified purposes, and exposes rights/withdrawal access.
checks.verify: Review Act s5 and final Rule 3 against the actual collection flow.

checks.title: Consent capture and withdrawal
runtime_tests: Use a synthetic account to give consent, then withdraw it through the ordinary product flow; confirm withdrawal is comparably easy and downstream consent-based processing stops prospectively.
checks.verify: Check Act s6 requirements; do not assume consent is the only permitted ground.

checks.title: Consent UX and default-choice integrity
runtime_tests: Load the consent UI in a clean browser state; verify optional consent is not pre-selected, reject/required-only remains usable, and no consent-dependent processing fires before the affirmative choice.
checks.verify: Treat this as a technical/UX evidence check supporting valid affirmative consent; validate legal interpretation against current primary sources.

checks.title: Consent evidence and change history
runtime_tests: Give and withdraw consent with a synthetic account; confirm the system can evidence the event, purpose/version and withdrawal without exposing unnecessary personal data.
checks.verify: Validate the evidence model needed to demonstrate consent/withdrawal behavior; do not prescribe excessive logging.

checks.title: Specified legitimate uses
checks.verify: Where relying on Act s7, document the exact category and factual basis.

checks.title: Data Fiduciary general obligations
runtime_tests: Verify processor flows and accuracy/correction propagation where data is used for decisions or disclosures.
checks.verify: Review Act s8 obligations in context.

checks.title: Reasonable security safeguards
runtime_tests: In an isolated environment, test access controls, least privilege, tenant isolation, recovery/logging and relevant processor safeguards.
checks.verify: Review Act s8 and final Rule 6; validate controls technically rather than from policy text alone.

checks.title: Personal data breach response
runtime_tests: Run a tabletop/synthetic incident and verify detection, evidence preservation, escalation, affected-person communication and Board-notification workflow without causing a real incident.
checks.verify: Review Act s8 and final Rule 7.

checks.title: Erasure and retention
runtime_tests: Delete a synthetic account/request and trace active stores, processors and backup handling; verify documented retention exceptions.
checks.verify: Review Act s8 and final Rule 8/Schedule where applicable.

checks.title: Published business contact
runtime_tests: Open the live/pre-release product and verify the required contact mechanism is reachable from the relevant notice/product surface.
checks.verify: Check final Rule 9 and applicable Act duties.

checks.title: Children and persons with lawful guardians
runtime_tests: Where applicable, test parent/guardian verification with synthetic accounts and verify prohibited/limited tracking or targeted-ad behavior is not triggered.
checks.verify: Review Act s9 and final Rules 10-12 including exemptions; an age checkbox alone is not validation.

checks.title: Access, correction, erasure and nomination rights
runtime_tests: Exercise synthetic access, correction, erasure and nomination requests and verify authentication, routing and resulting changes.
checks.verify: Review Act ss11-14 and final Rule 14.

checks.title: Grievance redressal
runtime_tests: Submit a synthetic grievance and verify acknowledgement, routing, ownership and stated response workflow.
checks.verify: Review Act s13 and final Rule 14.

checks.title: Significant Data Fiduciary governance, assessment and technical duties
runtime_tests: If currently designated as an SDF, verify the annual DPIA/audit calendar, evidence that significant observations can be furnished to the Board, and the operating process for reviewing technical measures including algorithmic software for risks to Data Principal rights.
If the Central Government has specified personal data under Rule 13(4), verify the relevant data and traffic-data transfer restriction against actual processing/storage flows.
checks.verify: Apply only with current Central Government designation evidence. Review Act s10 and final Rule 13, including annual DPIA/audit, reporting significant observations to the Board, algorithmic/technical-measure due diligence, DPO/auditor duties, and any conditional Rule 13(4) transfer restriction.

checks.title: Cross-border transfer restrictions
runtime_tests: Where tooling permits, verify actual storage/processing regions against declared vendor/subprocessor regions.
checks.verify: Check Act s16, final Rule 15 and any current Central Government restrictions; do not assume blanket localisation.

checks.title: Consent Manager registration
checks.verify: Apply the 2026-11-13 date to Act s6(9)/Rule 4 registration only. Ordinary apps are not automatically Consent Managers. If the product uses a registered Consent Manager, separately review the later-effective Act s6(7)-(8) use/accountability duties when they commence.

checks.title: Claimed exemption evidence
checks.verify: Never infer a startup or other exemption from size/name alone; retain official evidence and re-check scope.
